blood.name: Blood Pact
blood.desc: +30% attack speed, but you cannot heal.

doom.name: Doom Clock
doom.desc: +25% move speed, but lose 90 seconds on the clock.

toll.name: Greed’s Toll
toll.desc: +60% coin, but enemies have 25% more HP.

feral.name: Feral Pact
feral.desc: Companions deal +40% damage, but abilities recharge 50% slower.

blind.name: Blind Faith
blind.desc: +1 pierce and +20% damage, but no minimap.

dark.name: Darkness
dark.desc: You can only see close to you.

fog.name: Poison Fog
fog.desc: You and your companions lose health until the room is clear.

silence.name: Silence
silence.desc: Companion abilities and combos are sealed.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.desc: Enemies attack faster. Companions earn 50% more XP.

hunter.name: Hunter’s Moon
hunter.desc: Twice as many wild creatures. Enemies have 20% more HP. +20% Keeper XP.

iron.name: Iron Will
iron.desc: Enemies hit 40% harder. +60% coin and +50% Keeper XP.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.desc: Two more enemies per room. +30% coin and more buff orbs.
